title: The Tripitaka Koreana blocks are carved
summary: Woodworkers carved the Tripitaka Koreana’s extensive Buddhist text collection onto printing blocks between 1237 and 1248. The blocks survive at Haeinsa in Korea.

claims.text: Woodworkers carved the Tripitaka Koreana’s extensive Buddhist text collection onto printing blocks between 1237 and 1248. The blocks survive at Haeinsa in Korea.
